raw: The very same as the one she holds in her hands.
content: The very same as the one she holds in her hands.

raw: He lowers his head and rubs the tome lightly with his palms, as if completely unaware—of the thorns digging into his hands, of the bright blood trickling down.
content: He lowers his head and rubs the tome lightly with his palms, as if completely unaware—of the thorns digging into his hands, of the bright blood trickling down.

raw: Her chaotic thoughts all freeze in this moment.
content: Her chaotic thoughts all freeze in this moment.

raw: In the end, thousands of words condense into one—
content: In the end, thousands of words condense into one—

speaker: Lavinia
content: Why?

speaker: Bernardo
content: The game is over, Lavinia.

raw: That sentence alone is already enough for her.
content: That sentence alone is already enough for her.

raw: Only a few moments of silence pass, but she is already sapped of all her strength.
content: Only a few moments of silence pass, but she is already sapped of all her strength.

raw: Lavinia turns to leave and does not look back, frightened of the tears about to roll from her eyes.
content: Lavinia turns to leave and does not look back, frightened of the tears about to roll from her eyes.

raw: Bernardo remains in place, uttering not a single word as a few drops of his blood dye the floor.
content: Bernardo remains in place, uttering not a single word as a few drops of his blood dye the floor.
